purpose: Full primary-document scan for the 45 Scrivener/Robinson inflectional forms of the sozo and soteria families relevant to Spanish salvación, rescate, preservación, and sanidad
methodLimits: Normalized exact forms are derived from the authoritative Scrivener/Robinson occurrences and exclude proper names that merely begin with sos- or soter-.
Every occurrence retains primary context, date metadata, place, and editorial flags.
Potential exact-form homographs remain visible for human review; the result is exhaustive for the canonical forms queried, not for every possible Greek inflection.
No result is exposed to the canonical translation model.
